zh-CN.Totals and nominal dimensions are useful: 把项目保存到历史记录，必要时导出 PDF 或打印切割清单。完成后对比实际余料，下次类似项目会规划得更准。
zh-CN.Review Cost at the Purchase Boundary: Review Cost at the Purchase Boundary
zh-CN.Judge material by full sheets and purcha: Judge material by full sheets and purchasable stock, not theoretical part area. Include delivery, substitutions, specialty thicknesses, damaged-sheet risk, reusable offcuts, and the point where a small dimension change triggers another sheet. For installed work, add the labor and schedule impact of field fitting or replacement. The cheapest-looking input is not cheaper if it creates another trip or rebuild.
zh-CN.Translate the approved plan into referen: Translate the approved plan into reference faces, first cuts, setup groups, part IDs, inspection points, and safe support. Approve one sample before repeating an operation, especially when hardware clearance, paired parts, or a locked stop controls the result. Labels should preserve project, cabinet, material, orientation, and revision through machining, assembly, delivery, and installation.
zh-CN.Close the Loop After the Build: Close the Loop After the Build
zh-CN.Record actual material purchased, substi: Record actual material purchased, substitutions, damaged or replacement parts, useful offcuts, setup changes, field-fit dimensions, and the installed result. Compare those facts with the approved plan and note why they differed. This project-specific evidence improves the next cut list, quote, material policy, and template far more than an undocumented success or a waste percentage by itself.

zh-CN.Kitchen Cabinet Cut List is the closest: Kitchen Cabinet Cut List is the closest WoodCutTool action page for this problem. Keep its output connected to the same material codes and part IDs used in purchasing and the shop. A tool can expose geometry and totals; it cannot make an incomplete input list correct.

zh-CN.Capture cabinet case size, door and face: 输入实际板材尺寸、锯缝、纹理方向和是否允许旋转。对个人项目来说，提前把这些参数设准，比开锯后返工更省时间。
zh-CN.A reviewable sequence is to Draw front a: 生成方案后不要只看利用率，还要检查窄条、余料、切割顺序和容易混淆的重复零件。可视化布局是开工前的最后审核点。
zh-CN.The highest-value check prevents this fa: The highest-value check prevents this failure: Using the bare cabinet side dimension can leave the panel short of doors, toe kicks, crown, or countertop lines and make a premium end look added on. Put that check immediately before the irreversible step. If the current evidence cannot resolve the question, pause the affected operation, preserve the material and revision state, and obtain a measurement, product specification, test piece, or approval rather than improvising.
